title: Transformers 现已支持 llama.cpp 量化格式
summary: Hugging Face 发布博客宣布，Transformers 库现已支持直接加载和运行 llama.cpp 的量化模型（GGUF 格式）。此前，llama.cpp 的量化模型主要面向 C++ 推理引擎，用户若想在 Python 生态中使用这些量化权重，往往需要额外的转换步骤或依赖第三方库。此次集成后，开发者可以在 Transformers 中直接加载 GGUF 文件，利用其量化优势在 CPU 或低显存 GPU 上高效推理。该功能降低了量化模型的使用门槛，使 PyTorch 生态与 llama.cpp 的量化成果得以互通，方便研究人员和开发者对比不同量化方案、快速部署轻量级模型。博客还介绍了支持的量化类型、加载方式及性能表现，标志着两大主流推理生态的进一步融合。
summary_en: Hugging Face announced in a blog post that the Transformers library now supports loading and running llama.cpp quantized models (GGUF format) directly. Previously, llama.cpp quantized models were mainly used with the C++ inference engine, and using these quantized weights in the Python ecosystem often required extra conversion steps or third-party libraries. With this integration, developers can load GGUF files directly in Transformers and leverage quantization for efficient inference on CPUs or low-VRAM GPUs. This lowers the barrier to using quantized models, bridges the PyTorch ecosystem with llama.cpp quantization, and makes it easier to compare quantization schemes and deploy lightweight models. The blog also covers supported quantization types, loading methods, and performance, marking further convergence of the two major inference ecosystems.
